summary: This directory manages a declarative automated form system that dynamically generates and renders form fields based on defined schemas. It centralizes components and types necessary for automatic form construction, field configuration, and external form control.
responsibilities: Dynamically generate form fields from provided schemas
Provide a declarative interface for form construction
Expose handles for external form submission control
Define configuration schemas for field rendering and layout
relationships: The AutoForm component uses schema definitions to orchestrate the rendering of multiple AutoField instances.
Form configuration properties define the layout and render overrides used by the AutoField components.
The AutoFormHandle provides external controllers access to the submission logic defined within the form's internal state.
designDecisions: Declarative API for schema-driven form generation
Separation of form container logic from individual field rendering
Strong typing for field properties and form configuration to ensure schema consistency
Provision of an external interface for imperative form control
